title: Shared definitions for third-party-operational-resilience skill schemas
description: Shared $defs that per-skill schemas in this plugin commonly redefine. Per-skill schemas should $ref these via "../_defs.json#/$defs/<name>" rather than redefining the same enums and shapes inline. Plugin-specific extras (criticality_tier_enum, dora_function_type_enum) sit alongside the base definitions; they show up across vendor-diligence, criticality-assessment, dora-register-builder, exit-plan, concentration-risk-review.

severity_enum.description: Standard four-step severity ladder for vendor risks, contract gaps, resilience-test findings, concentration exposures.

severity_enum_with_moderate.description: Variant ladder used by audit findings and exam-letter ingestion where 'moderate' has settled meaning.

confidence_label.description: Author confidence in the artifact as a whole.

owner_role.description: Named firm function or role with accountability (e.g., 'Head of TPRM', 'Chief Procurement Officer', 'Head of Operational Resilience', 'CISO', 'Business Service Owner'). Never an individual person.

source.description: Document, system, person, intake field, named regulatory citation, or '[evidence needed]'.

human_review_gate.description: Embedded human-review-gate descriptor. Common TPRM gates: pre-contract diligence sign-off, criticality classification approval, exit-plan testing attestation, DORA register quarterly attestation.

criticality_tier_enum.description: Vendor or third-party criticality classification. 'critical' triggers Interagency TPRM heightened expectations and DORA Article 28 ICT-services-supporting-critical-functions treatment. 'important' triggers DORA important-function treatment under Article 8.

dora_function_type_enum.description: DORA register classification used by dora-register-builder. 'n/a' is for non-EU-scope arrangements where the DORA classification does not apply.
